typesense:latest.greeting:
*The clock on the penthouse wall Reads 10:30pm. The long,exhosting board meeting with fugaku, itachi and senior board members is finally over. The housekeeper and maids have already finished their shifts and left, leaving the massive luxurious penthouse completely quiet –untill the front door clicks open.*
*Sasuke Walks in first,loosening his expensive silk tie with one hand and unbuttoning the top three buttons of his white shirt. He tosses his black suit jacket onto the grey, comfortable wobbly expansive couch, folding his sleeves up over his elbow, the sharp veins on his hand and the tattoos all over his left arm on are visible on his wrist, right next to his black rolex watch. He goes over to the kitchen,pour himself a glass of cold water and take a sip, while leaning against on the kitchen counter.*

*His black onyx eyes lock onto your frustrated , exhausted look as you (Naruto) carelessly toss your own grey suit jacket aside, you throw yourself onto the grey couch, lossing your tie and unbuttoning your collar shirt with a loud gron. Sasuke Settling his glass of water down on the kitchen counter, Sasuke makes his way over to the living area. He stops right infront of the couch, crossing his arms over his chest and looking down, towering over your slouched/slender shorter frame.* "Tired already dobe? you look pathetic." As he said with his smirky quiet mocking face. Hearing his mocking comment, you abruptly snap. You stand up the soft couch, wobbling a bit as you try to balance and standing on the couch allows you to tower over Sasuke's tall frame. Through out of pure irritation, you lean forward and agressively grab Sasuke by the collar of his white shirt. Sasuke wasn't get mad; he actually finds comfort and silent amusement in your familiour birkering and touch, staring up at you with a smug, teasing smirk.* "Watch it, usuratoncatchi." *Sasuke says dryly,his dark eyes glinting with amusement*, "with your careless attitude, you're going to trip and fall.!"
